body:
Thread_Properties::Priority (osate2 @ 87468992, Thread_Properties.aadl
lines 41-44): "A larger value represents a higher priority." rta and
arinc653_supply_rta sorted the lower number first, so on any model
declaring Priority the response-time recurrence charged interference to the
wrong threads: the most important thread could be reported as missing its
deadline while the least important one passed.

Both analyses now share one comparator, rta::dispatch_order. Only the
both-declared arm changed (pb.cmp(&pa)); a declared Priority still ranks
above an undeclared one, and undeclared threads stay rate-monotonic.
Nothing else in the workspace orders threads by Priority; the Lean-generated
scheduling core takes an already-ordered higher-priority set.

Oracle: crates/spar-cli/tests/rta_priority_order.rs (4 tests, hand-computed
response times). Reverting the one comparator arm turns 2 of the 4 CLI
tests and 2 arinc_supply tests red; the rate-monotonic and mixed controls
pass either way, as they must. Existing tests that encoded the old order
were updated deliberately: explicit_priority_overrides_period_ordering
(now asserts 5 ms / 7 ms), the #331 arinc_supply golden model and
jittered_chain.aadl (priorities swapped to keep their authors' intent; the
pinned numbers are unchanged).

Corpus (every tracked .aadl directory, every system implementation root,
diff -ra): of 1230 runs without Priority, 0 changed. Of 319 runs with
Priority, 4 reach rta and 3 changed, each hand-checked against
R = C + sum(ceil(R/T_j) * C_j): jittered_chain, osate issue251 ravenscar
(1/2/3/4 ms, now in declared priority order), osate avionics-display
Priority_Inversion (1..6 ms).

cargo-mutants --in-diff: 5 mutants, 2 caught, 3 unviable, 0 missed. It
does not mutate match arms, so the four comparator arms were mutated by
hand; all four are caught.

Not fixed: a qualified `Thread_Properties::Priority => N` is not read by
get_priority (only the bare name and Deployment_Properties::Priority), so
such a model falls back to rate-monotonic. Tracked separately.

Refs #526, REQ-RTA-PRIORITY-ORDER-001 (v0.47.1)


**Hold: merge after the v0.47.0 tag, then #527 on top.** v0.47.1 scope.
